critical_code_review_comments: Backend uvicorn --reload watches /app/backend recursively — writing anything under /app/backend/tests triggers a reload storm that stalls active HTTPS/WS clients for ~5 minutes (reproduced this iteration). Mitigation applied: placed new suite at /app/tests/test_auth_rbac.py (outside watched dir) after `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`. RECOMMEND server.py/uvicorn config: narrow --reload-dir to server modules OR move backend/tests → /app/tests permanently to prevent future storms.

Problem statement referenced data-testid=`page-login` but the actual attribute on LoginPage.jsx line 34 is `login-page`. Not blocking (all other page-* testids follow the `page-<name>` convention e.g. page-drones, page-cctv). Consider renaming to `page-login` for consistency.

auth.py: login endpoint does NOT check user.active before issuing a JWT — inactive users can still obtain a token (though /auth/me and any protected route correctly rejects them via current_user dependency). Minor hardening: return 401 at login for inactive accounts to avoid leaking that credentials are valid.
auth.py: bcrypt hashing happens synchronously in seed_users + login — under load this blocks the FastAPI event loop. Consider `run_in_executor` wrapper. Non-blocking for demo scale.
auth.py: /api/users returns raw Mongo docs with `_id` popped into `id` but leaves other internals; a Pydantic response_model would enforce shape and hide any future accidental field additions.
DroneSurveillance.jsx: fetches /api/drones without a loading state — briefly shows '0 DRONES STREAMING' on first paint (~1-3s). Consider a small skeleton like Replay page now has.
server.py assistant model 'gpt-5.4' still referenced (fallback works, pre-existing note from iter 4).
